description: This file defines extension methods for configuring an in-memory, non-persistent reminder service within the Orleans framework. It adds methods to set up the reminder storage for development and testing scenarios, including registering singleton services and configuring the silo builder.

classes.name: SiloBuilderReminderMemoryExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for configuring in-memory reminder storage on the silo builder and service collection.

methods.name: UseInMemoryReminderService
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use an in-memory reminder service, primarily for development and testing.

methods.name: UseInMemoryReminderService
methods.description: Configures the service collection to use an in-memory reminder table, registering necessary singleton services.
